As a customer-centric organization, Lenovo was looking for solutions that would enable its support teams to rapidly manage customer inquiries, while streamlining and automating repetitive tasks for its agents. Key components included Dynamics 365 Contact Center delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Contact Center, where Dynamics 365 Contact Center assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Enhancing the support experience Now customers can interact with Copilot and Lenovo Premier Support customer service reps in nine different languages, 24 hours a day.
